trigger_condition: POST /api/visits or owner visit endpoint with null or omitted date; record accepts it
guard_snippet: if (date == null) { throw new IllegalArgumentException("date must not be null"); }
potential_consequence: Visit saved with null date; Pet.getVisits() sort NPEs, so every toPetDto of that pet fails with 500

trigger_condition: PUT /api/pets/{id} with empty-string name; constructor only rejects null or over 30 chars
guard_snippet: if (name == null || name.isEmpty() || name.length() > 30) { throw new IllegalArgumentException("name"); }
potential_consequence: Empty name passes DTO validation, then fails entity @NotEmpty at save, surfacing as 500 not 400

trigger_condition: Entity to DTO mapping of persisted data violating record constructor bounds (null type, negative id, null visit pet)
guard_snippet: @ExceptionHandler(IllegalArgumentException.class) // or validate entity before mapping to DTO
potential_consequence: Outbound mapping throws IllegalArgumentException from the constructor; response is 500 after the save already committed
